segments.motivation: To organize team tasks, track progress, and facilitate collaboration on projects.
To manage personal to-dos, set goals, and organize their own workload efficiently.
To plan, track, and report on project progress, ensuring tasks are completed on time.

tasks.purpose: to ensure timely completion of responsibilities
to centralize information and avoid email chains

benefits.claim: Provides a clear, visual overview of tasks and project progress.
Centralizes task information and communication, reducing clutter from emails.
Improves efficiency by simplifying workflows and automating repetitive actions.

frictions.claim: Difficulty in generating comprehensive, high-level reports or cross-board analytics for complex projects.
Challenges in managing intricate dependencies across many boards or large-scale, interconnected projects.
Limited native features for advanced project management functions like detailed resource allocation or budgeting.
